## Tickets

### POLISH-026: Dialog footers stay on screen

**Goal**: At the size Channel Properties opens at, Add shows shows **Next**
and Show Properties shows OK / Cancel / Apply without scrolling. Closes
UI-dialog-footer-below-fold.

**Scope**: Make the action row of every window dialog stick to the bottom of
the scrolling body (`.dialog-actions` and the sheet footer: `position:
sticky; bottom: 0` on the dialog's surface colour, with a top border so it
reads as XP's button row) or render it as a dialog child outside the body;
pick whichever keeps `WindowDialog`'s one `children` slot. Raise the
`channel-properties` placement in `apps/web/src/desktop/programs.ts` from
600 to 640 tall so the common Show Properties case needs no scroll. Add a
browser-walk assertion that **Next** in Add shows and **OK** in Show
Properties have a bounding box inside the dialog's visible box before any
scroll.

**Out of scope**: Dialog widths; the Rule dialog's footer (decision 10).

**Blocking dependencies**: None.

**Implementation notes**: Measured on 2026-11-03: Add shows body 520px in a
493px box; Show Properties General with Custom plays-at-a-time 718px. The
sticky row must not paint over the first-paint fade or the busy dim
(`controls.css` `.table-scroll`); check the Discover collections dialog,
whose cards are long, still scrolls cleanly.

**Verification**: `npm test --workspace @krazitv/web`; the browser suite's
new assertions run in CI.

**Docs impact**: None; wiki screenshots are regenerated at the end of the
pass.

### POLISH-027: "Can't reach kraziTV" when a request never reaches the server

**Goal**: Every feedback box says "Can't reach kraziTV. Check that it is
running, then press Refresh." when a request fails before the server answers.
Closes UI-network-error-verbatim.

**Scope**: In `apps/web/src/http/` word a non-`ApiError` failure, an
`AbortError` or `TimeoutError` from the request timeout, and `request_failed`
as that one sentence, so `RequestFeedback` and every other `error.message`
render site shows it; reuse the words the tray uses in
`desktop-shell.tsx` and TV in `screen-message.tsx`, keeping them in one place.
Tests in `refusal-words.test.ts` or a `request-feedback` test for a
`TypeError("Failed to fetch")` and a `TimeoutError`.

**Out of scope**: Retrying requests automatically.

**Blocking dependencies**: None.

**Verification**: `npm test --workspace @krazitv/web`.

**Docs impact**: `wiki/Troubleshooting.md` names the sentence and what to do.

### POLISH-028: Remaining developer words

**Goal**: Spec 0002's grep target holds and the special preview, scan dialog,
and My Channels speak the screen's words. Closes UI-developer-words-remain
(web strings), UI-filler-vs-off-air, and the UI-scan-summary-vocabulary
residual.

**Scope**: `channels-app.tsx` intro ("Give each channel a number and a name,
then add its shows on the Lineup tab. kraziTV handles what airs and when."),
empty state ("No channels yet. Create a channel, then add its shows."), and
the retry button ("Retry stopping the broadcast"); `removal-messages.ts`
("plays one of these items as a show. Change that show first." and the
plural); `progress-reset-dialog.tsx` ("What is airing now finishes; the
schedule after it is rebuilt."); `special-preview.tsx` ("Off air before it:",
"Off air inside it:", "No program fits; the channel is off air for the whole
range."); `scan-progress-dialog.tsx` ("Reading media files…", "Last read:")
and the browser-walk assertion at `desktop.browser.ts:426-428`. Update the
jsdom tests that read the old words.

**Out of scope**: Server messages (POLISH-029); "round" in the Marathons
control, which is explained in place.

**Blocking dependencies**: None.

**Verification**: `npm test --workspace @krazitv/web`; grep
`apps/web/src` for `assignment`, `reservation`, `regenerat`, `revision`,
`schedule entry`, `programming source`, `filler`, `prob(e|ing)` in string
literals and JSX text and find none in the domain sense.

**Docs impact**: `wiki/Specials.md` drops "what the preview calls filler";
`wiki/My-Channels.md` and `wiki/Media-Library.md` if they quote the old
sentences.

### POLISH-029: Four refusal codes and the marathon-length check

**Status**

Complete on 2026-11-03. `refusalWords` words `media_collection_in_use`,
`programming_member_assigned` (now shared by Add shows and Show Properties),
`programming_rule_stretch_invalid`, and `programming_rule_stretch_conflict`,
the last naming the rule from a new `ruleName` detail; `stretchProblem` gained
`shorter` and `unit` checks against Plays at a time, so Show Properties holds
OK and Apply with "Make the marathon longer than Plays at a time" and maps the
server's empty-path stretch issue to the same sentence.

**Goal**: The owner never reads "assignment", "reservation", or "stretch" in
a refusal. Closes UI-developer-words-remain (server codes) and
UI-marathon-length-refusal-verbatim.

**Scope**: Owner sentences beside `refusal-words.ts` for
`media_collection_in_use` ("This collection is in a channel's lineup or a
special. Remove it there first."), `programming_member_assigned` (shared by
Add shows and Show Properties: "Another show on this channel already plays
that."), `programming_rule_stretch_invalid`, and
`programming_rule_stretch_conflict` (name the rule and say what to change).
In `stretch-fields.tsx` add a third `StretchProblem`, "shorter", checked
against the per-sitting draft so Apply is held with "Make the marathon longer
than Plays at a time", and map the server's empty-path stretch issue to the
same sentence as a fallback. Tests for each code and for the held Apply.

**Out of scope**: Changing the server's codes or messages (decision 1 keeps
them as logs).

**Blocking dependencies**: None.

**Verification**: `npm test --workspace @krazitv/web`.

**Docs impact**: None.

### POLISH-030: Last empty states and the TMDB pointer

**Goal**: No first-run empty state is text only, and the TMDB task is
reachable after the balloon is gone. Closes the
UI-empty-states-without-a-next-step residual,
UI-preview-tab-blank-when-nothing-airs, and UI-tmdb-task-hidden-after-balloon
(decision 13).

**Scope**: Thread `openProgram` from `CollectionPropertiesApp` through
`CollectionEditor` to `CatalogPicker` and render **Open Media Library** in
its empty-catalog state (decision 2). In `upcoming-programming.tsx`, when
there are no turns and no skips, render `offAirWords("schedule_gap")`. Change
the Account Settings description in `programs.ts` to "Your name, picture,
password, and TMDB" (it feeds the desktop, Start, and the status bar). While
no TMDB key is set, Media Library's intro line ends with **Set up TMDB…**,
opening Account Settings on that task through `openProgram`; read the key
state the way `tmdb-tray-reminder.tsx` does. jsdom tests for each.

**Out of scope**: Moving the task (decision 13).

**Blocking dependencies**: None.

**Verification**: `npm test --workspace @krazitv/web`.

**Docs impact**: `wiki/Account-Settings.md` and `wiki/The-Desktop.md` for the
new description; `wiki/Media-Library.md` for the link; `wiki/Collections.md`
for the button.

### POLISH-031: Quiet saves and plain failure words

**Goal**: Sheets apply silently and a library row never shows ffprobe's text.
Closes UI-generic-success-message and UI-raw-error-text-in-rows.

**Scope**: Remove the "Operation completed successfully." default from
`useMutation` in `use-resource.ts`; let the callers that need a sentence
(root enable and disable, rename) pass their own, as removal does. Drop the
inline `probeError` from the library row and show it in Media details under a
"Why" fact worded "kraziTV could not read this file" with the stored text as
a tooltip. Word the "Lookup error" and "Refresh error" facts, the automatic
collection's maintenance failure, and the Filter dialog's load failure as one
owner sentence each ("TMDB could not be reached; kraziTV will try again."),
raw text in a `title` only. Update the tests that read the old sentence.

**Out of scope**: Changing what the server stores.

**Blocking dependencies**: None.

**Verification**: `npm test --workspace @krazitv/web`.

**Docs impact**: `wiki/Media-Library.md` if it describes the red text.

### POLISH-033: Session failure releases through the helper

**Goal**: `fail` in the signal session uses `ProcessBinding.release` like
every other transition, so a prepared process's held output is discarded and
its stall watch cancelled. Closes CODE-signal-session-fail-teardown.

**Scope**: In `ffmpeg-signal-session.ts`'s `fail`, after settling readiness
and ending the output, `for (const binding of this.bindings.values()) void
binding.release(() => undefined);` in place of the two hand-rolled loops.
`stop` keeps its own awaited path. A unit test with `FakeProcess` that a
prepared binding's held output is discarded when the active process fails.

**Out of scope**: Any change to what the stand-in does (ADR 0020).

**Blocking dependencies**: None.

**Verification**: `npm test --workspace @krazitv/signal`, `npm run
test:ffmpeg`.

**Docs impact**: None.

### POLISH-036: Add shows derivations leave the dialog

**Goal**: `add-shows-dialog.tsx` reads as pages, picks, and the request, and
the per-show derivations are tested directly. Closes
CODE-add-shows-dialog-derivations.

**Scope**: Move the pure derivations (`keyOf`, `membersOf`, `hasCollection`,
`labelOf`, `pathOf`, `suggestionFor`, `choose`, `modeOf`, `stretchDraftOf`,
`perSitting`, `unfinished`) into one module under `lineup/picks/` (or
`show-draft.ts` if they fit beside its functions) as functions of
`(shows, grouping, name, chosen, suggestionFor)` returning the label,
per-sitting words, and problem per show; test them directly; the component
keeps pages, picks, and the request. No behavior change.

**Out of scope**: Changing what the dialog does.

**Blocking dependencies**: POLISH-035.

**Verification**: `npm test --workspace @krazitv/web`; `npm run
audit:strict`.

**Docs impact**: None.

### POLISH-038: Docs, statuses, and the glossary term

**Goal**: Every doc the audit named is right. Closes
DOCS-spec-0003-release-readiness-status,
DOCS-env-example-public-base-url-browser,
DOCS-media-role-exit-gate-paraphrase, and
DOCS-glossary-schedule-preview-missing.

**Out of scope**: The feature README's and spec 0004's own status lines,
which the wave that completes the last ticket sets.

**Blocking dependencies**: None.
